six_case_input.note: First two use original article queries; natural/control query and semantic_query are byte-identical.

confirmed_observations: Default natural theft returns final JSON only within thinking; content is empty despite stop and 199 output tokens.
Default natural drunk driving final attempts emit thinking until cancellation; completed token counts/done_reason are unavailable.
Actual HTTP default request omits think; candidate final request includes think=false, native JSON schema and num_predict=1024.
Native candidate produces structurally valid positive final answers, but incorrectly matches both theft elements on missing and denied facts in both sequential runs.
Removing string enum or using booleans preserves false positives; explicitly enabling thinking exhausts 1024 tokens without content for the three tested inputs.
limits: Observed behavior is bounded to these model, corpus, inputs, prompts and budgets; it does not prove all protocols or larger models will fail.
Format/source/name validation does not establish factual support; candidate is not default enabled.
No model switch/download, HTTP server launch, deployment, commit, merge, archive or Done transition.
Partial cancelled responses retain null token/done metrics; internal think=None is distinct from absence on HTTP wire.
reviewable_choices: Authorize an explicit stronger final-generation model and rerun unchanged positive/negative controls twice.
Accept a reduced demo limited to retrieval, article reading and candidates without relying on model element-match claims.
